'''Uru-Eu-Wau-Wau''' ({{Langx|urz|Jupaú|links=no}}) is one of the eight varieties of the [[Kagwahiva language]], a [[Tupi–Guarani language]], Subgroup VI.<ref name="world">{{cite web |url=http://www.minorityrights.org/5310/brazil/urueuwauwau.html |title=Urueu-Wau-Wau |work=World Directory of Minorities and Indigenous Peoples |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150702004933/http://www.minorityrights.org/5310/brazil/urueuwauwau.html |archive-date=2015-07-02 |access-date=22 May 2011 }}</ref> The name is also spelled ''Uru-Eu-Uau-Uau'', ''Eru-Eu-Wau-Wau'' and ''Ureuwawau'', and is sometimes known simply as ''Kagwahiva''.<ref name="lang">{{cite web |url=http://www.ethnologue.com/%5C/15/show_language.asp?code=urz |title=Uru-Eu-Wau-Wau |work=[[Ethnologue]] |publisher=[[SIL International]] |url-access=subscription |access-date=26 April 2011 }}</ref>
